description: Use for any question about CEM (the Compounding Execution Method) or a term it defines, such as the Drift Tax, the Pendulum, the Governor, Sweeps, Cycles or operator levels, and for questions about building or operating with AI that CEM's research covers. Returns CEM's own definition with its code (cite it, e.g. F-003) and the best research documents, each with its code, one-line summary and page. Free and instant. Use it first; ask_cem writes a longer answer when someone wants to go deeper.
